description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District (24/1196)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act, including specific land parcel details, ownership declarations, property boundaries, and land rights. It contains multiple declarations by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement regarding title determinations for specific land parcels in Mallawapitiya, Kurunegala District, with detailed schedules showing parcel numbers, owners, extents, and encumbrances. This fits precisely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it focuses entirely on land and property-related matters.
